articles.title: One Singapore ship was sunk, but here's why others are still transiting the Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: Commercial vessels may continue navigating the perilous Strait of Hormuz despite escalating attacks on shipping, as strong demand for Middle Eastern energy and commercial opportunities keep some operators willing to brave the risks, maritime experts said.
